# explosionprooftablets.com — Full Reference

> Independent engineering reference for ATEX and IECEx certified intrinsically safe tablets for hazardous areas.

## Product 1: ecom Tab-Ex 03 DZ2

- Type: Dedicated Android Ex tablet
- Certification: ATEX / IECEx Zone 1/21
- Zone: 1
- Protection concept: Intrinsic safety (Ex ib)
- Operating system: Android 13
- Display: 10.1 inch TFT
- Base device: Samsung Galaxy Tab
- Weight: ~690 g
- IP rating: IP68
- Price: ~€3,200 (ex VAT)
- Gas group: IIC
- Key advantage: Samsung Galaxy Tab-based, familiar UX. Zone 1 rated.
- Manufacturer: ecom instruments (Pepperl+Fuchs), Germany
- Website: https://www.ecom-ex.com

## Product 2: ecom Tab-Ex Pro DZ2

- Type: Dedicated Android Ex tablet
- Certification: ATEX / IECEx Zone 1/21
- Zone: 1
- Operating system: Android 13
- Display: 10.1 inch AMOLED
- Weight: ~750 g
- IP rating: IP68
- Price: ~€3,800 (ex VAT)

- Manufacturer: ecom instruments (Pepperl+Fuchs), Germany

## Product 3: i.safe MOBILE IS930.1

- Type: Dedicated Android Ex tablet

- Zone: 1

- Display: 8 inch IPS
- Weight: ~570 g
- IP rating: IP68
- Price: ~€2,400 (ex VAT)

## Product 4: Aegex 10 IS

- Type: Dedicated Windows Ex tablet
- Certification: ATEX / IECEx Zone 1
- Zone: 1
- Operating system: Windows 10/11
- Display: 10.1 inch IPS
- Weight: ~850 g
- IP rating: IP65
- Price: ~€4,500 (ex VAT)
- Gas group: IIC
- Key advantage: Full Windows for legacy enterprise applications, SAP, SCADA. Stylus support.
- Manufacturer: Aegex Technologies, USA
- Website: https://aegex.com

## Product 5: Getac F110-Ex

- Type: Rugged Windows Ex tablet
- Certification: ATEX Zone 2
- Zone: 2 only (NOT Zone 1)
- Operating system: Windows 11
- Display: 11.6 inch IPS
- Weight: ~1.4 kg
- IP rating: IP66
- Price: ~€3,800 (ex VAT)
- Gas group: IIC
- Key advantage: Large screen, full Windows power.
- Key limitation: Zone 2 only — cannot be used in Zone 1 areas.
- Manufacturer: Getac, Taiwan
- Website: https://getac.com

## Product 6: Zebra XPAD L10 IS

- Type: Enterprise Ex tablet
- Certification: ATEX / IECEx Zone 2
- Zone: 2 only (NOT Zone 1)
- Operating system: Android / Windows
- Display: 10.1 inch
- Weight: ~1.1 kg
- IP rating: IP65
- Price: ~€3,500 (ex VAT)
- Gas group: IIC
- Key advantage: Enterprise MDM ecosystem. Dual OS availability.
- Key limitation: Zone 2 only — cannot be used in Zone 1 areas.
- Manufacturer: Zebra Technologies (Xplore), USA
- Website: https://zebra.com

## Product 7: Xshielder iPad Pro 11

- Type: iPad Ex case (Apple iPad Pro in certified flameproof enclosure)
- Certification: ATEX Zone 1/21 — PENDING as of August 2026; IECEx planned
- Marking (design): II 2G Ex db IIC T6 Gb / II 2D Ex tb IIIC T80°C Db, Tamb −20°C to +45°C
- Standards: EN IEC 60079-0:2018, EN 60079-1:2014, EN 60079-31:2014
- Protection concept: Flameproof enclosure (Ex db) — not intrinsic safety
- Base device: Apple iPad Pro 11" M5 (2025) or M4 (2024), iPadOS
- Display: 11 inch Ultra Retina XDR tandem OLED, 1,600 nits peak
- Weight: ~1,400 g total; dimensions 289 × 217 × 16 mm
- IP rating: IP65 (pending testing)
- Other: Face ID, 12MP camera + LiDAR, 8,160 mAh battery, eSIM only, NS-9611 lanyard hole
- Price: On request
- Key advantage: First announced iPad Pro solution for Zone 1 — brings iPadOS, Apple silicon, and Apple MDM (ABM/Jamf/Intune) into hazardous areas.
- Key limitation: Certification pending — cannot be deployed in classified areas until the certificate is issued.
- Manufacturer: Xshielder, Norway
- Website: https://xshielder.com/products/atex-ipad

## Product 8: Xciel XCZ1 iPad mini series

- Type: iPad Ex enclosure (flameproof, factory-fitted — self-install not permitted)
- Certification: ATEX / IECEx Zone 1 (manufacturer)
- Base device: Apple iPad mini 4, 5, 6, or 7 (8.3 inch on mini 7), iPadOS
- Price: ~$3,150 (mini 7 enclosure only); ~$3,795 full kit with mounting, stylus, cases; enclosure + iPad bundles available
- Availability: Shipping now — the only shipping Zone 1 iPad solution as of August 2026
- Accessories: magnet mounting, locking system, stylus, ballistic nylon case, chest harness
- Manufacturer: Xciel Inc, Texas, USA
- Website: https://www.xciel.com/rugged-ipads

## Product 9: Xciel XCRiPad series

- Type: iPad rugged Ex case
- Certification: NEC Class 1 Division 2 / ATEX Zone 2 (manufacturer)
- Base devices: broad coverage — iPad (gen 6–11), iPad Air, iPad Pro 11" (2019–2025), iPad mini 4–7
- Price: ~$1,470–$1,680 (case only), e.g. XCRiPad Pro 11" at $1,680, XCRiPad mini 7 at $1,510
- Availability: Shipping now
- Manufacturer: Xciel Inc, Texas, USA
- Website: https://www.xciel.com/rugged-ipads

## Product 10: Atexxo Explosion Proof iPad (A16) (Ex Zone 2)

- Type: Factory-converted Apple iPad (casing + protected circuit modified; not a removable case)
- Certification: ATEX Zone 2/22 Unit Assessment Certificate — II 3G Ex ec ic IIC T4 Gc / II 3D Ex tc IIIB T135°C Dc (EU equivalent of NEC C1D2)
- Base device: Apple iPad 11 inch (A16), iPadOS; WiFi or WiFi+5G, 128–512 GB
- Weight: ~1,050 g; dimensions 28 × 21 × 1.6 cm
- Limitations: Touch ID disabled by conversion
- Price: On request
- Availability: Shipping now
- Manufacturer: Atexxo Manufacturing, Netherlands
- Website: https://atexxo.com/product/explosion-proof-ipad-a16-ex-zone-2/

## Product 11: Atexxo Explosion Proof iPad 11" (Ex Zone 1)

- Type: Factory-converted Apple iPad (flameproof conversion)
- Certification: ATEX II 2G Ex db IIC T4 Gb / II 2D Ex tb IIIA T135°C Db; IECEx Ex db IIC T4 Gb; CSA on request
- Base device: Apple iPad 11 inch, iPadOS; WiFi or WiFi+5G (eSIM only), 128–512 GB; blocked-camera variant available
- Weight: ~1,100 g; dimensions 27 × 20 × 2 cm
- Limitations: fingerprint scanner disabled by conversion
- Price: On request
- Availability: Expected Q3 2026 — announced, not yet shipping
- Manufacturer: Atexxo Manufacturing, Netherlands
- Website: https://atexxo.com/product/explosion-proof-ipad-11-inch-ex-zone-1/

## iPad in Hazardous Areas

As of August 2026, iPad solutions exist at three levels:
- Zone 1 shipping today: Xciel XCZ1 flameproof enclosures for the iPad mini 4–7 (Product 8) — the only shipping Zone 1 iPad option.
- Zone 2/22 shipping today: Atexxo factory-converted iPads (Product 10) and Xciel XCRiPad C1D2/Zone 2 cases (Product 9).
- Full-size Zone 1 announced, not yet shipping: Atexxo converted iPad 11" (Product 11, expected Q3 2026) and Xshielder iPad Pro 11 case (Product 7, certification pending) — the first for an iPad Pro.
For iPhone-based Zone 1 options, Xshielder offers ATEX Zone 1 certified Ex cases for the iPhone 17 Pro Max — see intrinsicallysafephones.com.

## Comparison Summary

For Zone 1 Android tablet needs, the ecom Tab-Ex 03 DZ2 is the industry standard, with the i.safe MOBILE IS930.1 as a compact alternative.
For Windows requirements in Zone 1, the Aegex 10 IS is the only option.
For Zone 2 deployments where a larger screen is needed, the Getac F110-Ex offers 11.6 inches of display.
For Apple ecosystem access in hazardous areas: Zone 1 today means the Xciel XCZ1 iPad mini enclosure or Xshielder iPhone Ex cases (intrinsicallysafephones.com); Zone 2 today means Atexxo converted iPads or Xciel XCRiPad cases; full-size Zone 1 iPads are announced by Atexxo (Q3 2026) and Xshielder (iPad Pro 11, certification pending).
